rewriteInstruction: Three fixes required. First: remove both causal claims about visitor behavior ('cold traffic may leave', 'This matters most when') — the evidence shows only text changes, not conversion or channel outcomes. Reframe as conditional observations: 'If a visitor does not recognize your brand, a headline that skips category explanation can create confusion.' Second: define 'category leadership positioning' in plain language in the same breath it appears — do not assume the reader knows what it means. Third: move the incognito test to the opening of the 'What it costs' H3 block so the founder takeaway lands in the first two sentences, not buried at the end. The section is specific and the evidence anchor is strong; the issue is unsupported cause-effect logic and jargon without translation.
